Original current_ref (iraq-businessnews) returns HTTP 401 live; an archived copy verifies via Wayback ($294m / pipeline present) but it concerns CPECC winning the EPSCC bid, not asset ownership. NO source corroborates GEM Owner 'Iraq Ministry of Oil 100%'. All independent sources (pipeline-journal, BC Insight/CRU, Zawya, TotalEnergies) describe the Ar-Ratawi GMP as part of the $10bn GGIP consortium: TotalEnergies 45% / Basrah Oil Company 30% / QatarEnergy 25%. Basrah Oil Company is the Iraqi state operator (under the Ministry of Oil), which may be why GEM assigned the Ministry, but a 100% Iraq Ministry of Oil ownership is unsupported and appears to conflict with the consortium structure. Flagging for Update review; leaving DEAD_LINK/unsupported for the stated owner value.
